content.value: The Procedure Codes Reference allows the user to retrieve the list of procedure codes for a specified encounter. The Procedure Documentation feature allows the user to view clinical details related to the procedures performed and billed for in the office. This is Practice-specific, HTML template-driven documentation related to specific procedures. When returned via API, all HTML is stripped out, and plain text is returned. This data may be difficult to parse. The Procedure Reference feature allows the user to view the configured list of procedures in the system.

primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Get procedure documentation for given encounter
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Retrieves the procedure documentation associated with a specific encounter.

inputParameters.name: showhtml
inputParameters.description: Procedure documentation is stored as HTML templates filled in by the practice.  By default, we strip out all HTML when returning the data back through the API.  However, there are times when preserving the HTML formatting may be useful. If SHOWHTML is set to true, the original HTML from the template is preserved when returning data back through the API.

inputParameters.name: showoutcomes
inputParameters.description: Some practices utilize encounters with procedure workflows to document additional information about the procedure, such as outcomes associated with the proceduredocumentation. If SHOWOUTCOMES is set to true, returns additional information about outcomes, if it exists.

inputParameters.name: limit
inputParameters.description: Number of entries to return (default 1000, max 10000)Please note that this endpoint has a different default and max than normal.

primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Vitals entered during the specified procedure stage.
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Retrieves vitals entered during the specified procedure stage associated with a given encounter.

inputParameters.name: showunits
inputParameters.description: Show units on vitals where applicable.

inputParameters.name: stage
inputParameters.description: Procedure stage to the retrieve the procedure vitals for.

abbreviation.description: Short human-readable string for this vital group. E.g., Ht.

key.description: Key for this vital group. E.g., HEIGHT.

ordering.description: Configured order for this vital group

readings.description: List of vital attribute readings. One entry per attribute (so the temperature and where the temperature was taken are two different readings, tied together by the readingid

clinicalelementid.description: Key used to identify this particular vital attribute

createdby.description: The athenaNet username of the person who entered the vital.

createddate.description: The date this vital was entered into the chart. Returned in mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi:ss format.

isgraphable.description: Flag indicating if this vital is graphable.

lastmodifiedby.description: The athenaNet username of the user that last modified the reading.

lastmodifieddate.description: The date this vital was last modified. Returned in mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi:ss format.

high.description: The highest value the y value could be.

low.description: The lowest value that y could be.

prefix.description: Indicator of less than or greater. Possible values: (>,<)

readingid.description: Numeric key used to tie related and distinguish separate readings. So the diastolic and systolic blood pressure should have the same readingid.

readingtaken.description: Date that the reading was taken.

unit.description: Unit that describes this vital's value.

value.description: The value of this reading. NOTE: for numeric values, the units are always in the 'native' units per the configuration.

vitalid.description: Unique ID for this vital attribute reading. Used to update/delete this reading.
